aggregation.conversation_macro: equal weight per conversation after within-conversation query mean

protocol.candidate_fitting: none; every candidate is frozen before outer evaluation
protocol.inner_selection: leave-one-conversation-out over the nine outer-training conversations
protocol.multiplicity: Holm correction across all declared metrics

one_standard_error_rule.choice: lowest frozen simplicity rank meeting the threshold
one_standard_error_rule.threshold: best inner conversation-macro mean minus its sample standard error

publication.reason: local diagnostic only; publication requires explicit review and approval
